c74object.name: el.vdb~
c74object.digest: Multichannel buffer-based variable delay line with feedback
c74object.description:
el.vdb~ is a multichannel variable delay line with feedback that uses an external buffer~ as its delay memory. Because feedback recirculation is computed internally on a sample-by-sample basis, delay times can be modulated down to sub-vector durations without minimum vector size constraints. The object features infinite hold (inf_hold) for looping the captured delay buffer without accepting new input, feedback limiter protection (protect), and continuous audio-rate modulation of both delay time and feedback gain. A float outlet reports the current read-head position in milliseconds.
Inlets
Inlets 1 to N (signal): Audio input channels 1 through N (determined by the chans attribute/argument, default: 1).
Inlet N+1 (signal / float): Delay time in milliseconds (clamped between 0.0 and maxdelay).
Inlet N+2 [Rightmost Inlet] (signal / float): Feedback gain coefficient (-1.0 to 1.0).
Outlets
Outlets 1 to N (signal): Delayed audio output channels 1 through N.
Rightmost Outlet (float): Read head phase. Emits the current read-head position in milliseconds.

inlet.description: Incoming audio signals to be delayed.
Delay time in milliseconds. Accepts float messages or audio-rate modulation signals.
Feedback gain multiplier. Accepts float messages or audio-rate modulation signals.

outlet.description: Current playback position of the read head in milliseconds.

objarg.name: buffername
objarg.description: Required. The name of the buffer~ used as the delay line memory.

objarg.name: chans
objarg.description: The number of audio channels in the delay line (default: 1, range: 1 to 64). Must match the channel count of the target buffer~.

objarg.name: maxdelay
objarg.description: The maximum delay time in milliseconds (default: 5000.0 ms). Cannot exceed the total duration of the target buffer~.

method.name: float
method.description: Float sent to inlet N+1 sets delay time in milliseconds. Float sent to inlet N+2 sets feedback gain.

method.name: inf_hold
method.description: When set to 1, freezes the current contents of the delay line in an infinite loop without recording incoming audio. When set to 0 (default), normal delay recording resumes.

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to float to set delay time or feedback.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence across all channels. When set to 0 (default), normal delay processing resumes.

method.name: protect
method.description: When set to 1, clamps feedback within ±0.99 to prevent runaway overload. When set to 0 (default), feedback gain is unconstrained.

method.name: show
method.description: Prints the current feedback gain and delay time in milliseconds to the Max Console.

method.name: signal
method.description: Signals arriving at inlets 1 through N are the audio channels to be delayed. Signals arriving at inlets N+1 and N+2 continuously modulate delay time and feedback at audio rate.

attribute.name: buffername
attribute.description: The name of the buffer~ object used as delay line memory.

attribute.name: chans
attribute.description: Number of audio channels in the delay line (default: 1, range: 1 to 64).

attribute.name: maxdelay
attribute.description: Maximum allowable delay time in milliseconds (default: 5000.0 ms).
